shots.name: 07-feedback-after-fix-done
steps: (async()=>{const w=(t=200)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,t));const out=[];for(let i=0;i<10;i++){await w(300);const h=document.querySelector('.hint-box')?.textContent;if(h)out.push(h);const pool=[...document.querySelectorAll('.choices .choice')];if(document.querySelector('.slots')){const q=pool.find(b=>/\?$/.test(b.textContent.trim()));q?.click();await w();document.querySelector('.choices .choice')?.click();await w();[...document.querySelectorAll('.btn')].find(b=>!b.hidden&&/확인하기/.test(b.textContent))?.click();}else if(pool.length){pool[0].click();}await w();const nx=[...document.querySelectorAll('.btn')].find(b=>!b.hidden&&/다음 문제|결과 보기/.test(b.textContent));if(!nx)break;nx.click();}return out.concat(document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent)})()
